Frequently asked questions

How do I restore my purchase on a new phone or after reinstalling?

Open Settings › Full access › Restore purchases (the button is also on the unlock screen). Use the same Apple ID or Google account you bought with. The app also checks quietly at start, so a reinstalled app usually unlocks by itself once it is online. On iPhone you can enter a promotional code with Redeem code.

Can my family use the unlock?

The unlock belongs to the Apple ID or Google account that bought it, and works on every phone or tablet signed in with that account – use Restore purchases there. Whether it can also be shared with a family group is shown on the app's store page (“Family Sharing” on the App Store, the family library on Google Play).

Does the app work without mobile data?

Yes for the stories and pictures: they are inside the app. The street map is loaded from OpenStreetMap and needs a connection; without one, the places and walks are still listed and readable.

Why does the app ask for my location, and can I say no?

Your location is used only on your phone, to show the “you are here” dot and the distance to each place. It is never stored or sent. You can say no – everything else works. To change it later: on iPhone, Settings › Privacy & Security › Location Services › British Footprints; on Android, Settings › Apps › British Footprints › Permissions › Location.

How do directions work in Apple Maps and Google Maps?

On a place page, tap Directions for walking directions to it. On a walk, tap Start the walk in Maps. Google Maps takes the whole walk with all its stops. Apple Maps gives walking directions to one stop at a time: mark the stop as visited and tap again for the next one. On iPhone the app asks once which maps app to use; you can change it in Settings. On Android, Google Maps is used for whole walks.

How do I turn off the usage statistics?

Open Settings and switch off Share anonymous usage statistics. The statistics are anonymous anyway – the privacy policy lists exactly what they contain.

How do I change the language or the dark/light theme?

In Settings, choose English or Turkish under Language, and Dark, Light or “Use phone setting” under Appearance. Stories without a translation are shown in English.

I found a mistake in a story. How do I report it?

Thank you! Please write to app@save-all.com with the name of the place, what is wrong and, if you can, a source. Every story lists its sources in the app, and corrections are included in the next update.

I bought the unlock, but places are still locked.

Make sure the phone is online and signed in to the store account you bought with, then tap Restore purchases in Settings › Full access. If a payment is still pending (for example Ask to Buy), the unlock arrives once it is approved. If it still does not work, write to us.
